title: Signed coordinate normalization predicate for a strict Roos shift
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category with countable products. For a complex $N$ of strict towers use the product complex $P(N)=\prod_nN_n$, the map $1-s$ and the existing functor $C(N)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$ [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. Let $\pi_{N,q,n}:P(N)^q\to N_n^q$ be its product projections, and write $v_{N,q}:C(N)^q\to P(N)^q$ and $u_{N,q}:C(N)^q\to P(N)^{q-1}$ for its unshifted and shifted product coordinates. Given a coherent integer-shift structure $c$ on this fixed functor [def-weil-triangulated-category], define ShiftFormula(c) to mean the following two projection equations for every $N$, all $r,q\in\mathbf Z$ and every $n\in\mathbf N$. After the canonical cochain reindexing identifications, the degree-$q$ component of $c_{N,r}:C(N[r])\to C(N)[r]$ followed by $v_{N,q+r}$ and $\pi_{N,q+r,n}$ equals $v_{N[r],q}$ followed by $\pi_{N[r],q,n}$ and the degree-$q$ shift identification of $N_n$. The same composite with $u_{N,q+r}$ and $\pi_{N,q+r-1,n}$ equals $(-1)^r$ times the composite with $u_{N[r],q}$ and $\pi_{N[r],q-1,n}$ followed by the degree-$(q-1)$ shift identification of $N_n$. Equivalently in the coordinate order (unshifted product, shifted product), the comparison is $(b,a)\mapsto(b,(-1)^ra)$. This names a predicate on a supplied coherent shift; it asserts no existence of such a shift or any derived-limit comparison.
